summary: Chemours filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, disclosing a settlement agreement with North Carolina and 11 local entities resolving PFAS and other emission claims tied to the Fayetteville Works facility. The aggregate payment is $455 million, payable over 15 years starting within 30 days. Consistent with the January 2021 MOU, Chemours bears 50% and DuPont/Corteva bear 50%. For the $4 billion qualified spend cap, the amount is applied at $210 million on a net present value basis. The agreement is subject to dismissal orders. Watch for court approvals and any future multi-year PFAS settlements.
